title: Learn English With My Morning Routine (Natural Speaking Practice)

header.titleZh: 透過我的早晨例行公事學習英語（自然口語練習）
header.titleEn: Learn English With My Morning Routine (Natural Speaking Practice)

sentences.en: Hello. Let me teach you English... while I show you my morning routine! My alarm went off at 9:58 a.m.
sentences.tc: 你好。讓我教你英文...同時向你展示我的早晨例行公事！我的鬧鐘在上午 9 點 58 分響了。

sentences.en: I pressed snooze and I took off my earplugs (because it's really noisy without them).
sentences.tc: 我按了小睡鍵，摘下了耳塞（因為沒有耳塞真的很吵）。

sentences.en: I open the curtains.
sentences.tc: 我打開窗簾。

sentences.en: I get my daily sun. I woke up feeling a little sick.
sentences.tc: 我每天都有陽光。我醒來時感覺有點不舒服。

sentences.en: I need to take a shower. My hair is very greasy! There's a band playing outside...
sentences.tc: 我需要洗澡。我的頭髮很油！外面有樂團在演奏...

sentences.en: I wanted to make a --I wanted to make a daily routine video. This is a highly requested daily routine video. So,.
sentences.tc: 我想製作一個——我想製作一個日常影片。這是一個要求很高的日常影片。所以，。

sentences.en: I want to show you everything. Obviously, not everything.
sentences.tc: 我想向你展示一切。顯然，並非一切。

sentences.en: I need my privacy, ...you understand? But everything I can. My voice is so hoarse. I've been sick for a couple days now.
sentences.tc: 我需要我的隱私，……你懂嗎？但我能做的一切。我的聲音是如此沙啞。我已經病了幾天了。
